text: There are criminal sub-cultures that do not share mainstream values. Some researchers suggest

text: Economic change in the last hundred years has resulted in many changes to the occupational
structure in modern industrial societies. One of the key changes has been the decline in the
number of blue collar workers and an increase in the number of white collar workers.
